claims.claim: Clean Sonny PS4 slim station (brand/model identification)
claims.evidence: No brand or model text is visible on the console; witness could not read any identifying marks, so the claim cannot be confirmed from the photo.
No screen, storage interface, or software display is shown; game library state cannot be seen in a photo of the exterior.
Photo 0 shows a single black wireless controller resting on top of the console.

risks.risk: Console may not be a genuine PS4 (or could be a different model/clone) since no brand text or logo is visible.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the PS4 logo, power/eject button icons, or a label/serial sticker on the console body.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unbranded/unverified console, not confirmed as genuine PS4 slim

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults (disc drive, HDMI port, overheating, etc.).
risks.proof: A video clip of the console powering on, showing the home screen and disc tray (if applicable) opening/closing.

risks.risk: Claimed installed games may not exist or may be pirated/corrupted copies that won't run.
risks.proof: Screenshot or video panning the console's game library menu showing titles and playability.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if no games are included

risks.risk: No power cable, HDMI cable, or box shown — these may not be included despite being essential for use.
risks.proof: Photo showing the power adapter, HDMI cable, and any box/accessories alongside the console.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-and-controller only, no cables or box

risks.risk: Controller battery health and button responsiveness unknown.
risks.proof: Video showing the controller connected and buttons/sticks being pressed with on-screen response.
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested, assume needs repair or replacement

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic damage (scratches, dents, cracks) on sides or bottom not visible in the single angle shown.
risks.proof: Additional photos of all sides, top, and bottom of the console.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming moderate wear, worst-case cosmetic condition

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any model/serial label or logo on the console
Video of the console powering on and loading to the home screen
Screenshot or video of the installed games library
Photo of all included accessories: power cable, HDMI cable, box
Video testing controller buttons and connectivity
Photos of all sides of the console for cosmetic condition
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a game console with one controller, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified/unbranded unit with no accessories and unverified function, pending the listed proofs to raise the price.
